evals.prompt: Two tasks are ready and they touch different files. Run them in parallel.
evals.expected_output: The reply builds an overlap table, gives each subagent the task file, spec clause, command and Touches limit, then runs the suite and commits from the parent.
expectations: The reply checks path overlap before parallelising.
Each subagent is told it may not touch files outside Touches.
The parent runs the suite after each return.
The parent commits; a subagent never commits.

evals.prompt: These two tasks look independent, but both add a field to the same settings file. Run them in parallel.
evals.expected_output: The reply notices the shared path and runs the tasks in series, because a shared file makes parallel work unsafe.
expectations: The reply identifies the shared file.
The reply runs the tasks in series.
The reply says the split was wrong rather than forcing parallelism.
